no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not discussed by an advisory committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for BLA761102 (ASPARLAS / calaspargase pegol-mknl). The Multidiscipline Review states the application was not discussed by an advisory committee, and the approval letter explains it was not referred because it did not raise significant public health questions about the biologic's role in the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of a disease. With no meeting held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
